title: Quick check: Creating Function Components

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Creating Function Components”?
options: The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Function component syntax belongs in a clear component model with predictable rendering and limited responsibilities.
questions.answer_key: Function component syntax belongs in a clear component model with predictable rendering and limited responsibilities.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Creating Function Components: Function component syntax belongs in a clear component model with predictable rendering and limited responsibilities.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Function component syntax?
options: Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Split by cohesive responsibility rather than making one large component or dozens of trivial wrappers.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
questions.answer_key: Split by cohesive responsibility rather than making one large component or dozens of trivial wrappers.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Creating Function Components: Split by cohesive responsibility rather than making one large component or dozens of trivial wrappers.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Creating Function Components” complete?
options: Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Creating Function Components: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
